name: Agents
author: omarchy-grok-cursor-usage contributors
description: Grok, Cursor, and Codex leftover quotas on the Omarchy bar, with remaining-over-time charts and even-burn pace.

barWidget.description: Stacked leftover meters and remaining-over-time charts for every AI coding subscription on the machine.

schema.label: Remaining style
schema.description: logo-on-bar is the SuperGrok mark with a horizontal remaining meter under it. logo-bar puts a vertical meter beside the mark. bar-percent is a wide meter plus a number. percent is the number alone.

schema.label: Show remaining percent
schema.description: Show the leftover percentage next to the mark or meter.

schema.label: Remaining chart range
schema.description: days is a 2-day span (1.8 days before now, 0.2 after, snapped to :00/:15/:30/:45). If the quota start is inside the lookback, the left edge is the quarter-hour at or before the first sample and width stays 2 days. If reset is within 2 days, the right edge is the reset and width stays 2 days. Both specials together may shorten the span. cycle is first sample through the reset.

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

schema.label: Snapshot file name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine, such as laptop.json or desktop.json.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.
